mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, MENU_URL, PARENT_MENU_ID, SEQ, POPUP_YN, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, CREATE_ID, UPDATE_ID, DEL_YN FROM T3000_MENU WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, MENU_URL, PARENT_MENU_ID, SEQ, POPUP_YN, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, CREATE_ID, UPDATE_ID, DEL_YN FROM T3000_MENU WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T3000_MENU ( MENU_NAME, MENU_URL, PARENT_MENU_ID, SEQ, POPUP_YN, CREATE_DT, CREATE_ID, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{menuName}, #{menuUrl}, #{parentMenuId}, #{seq}, #{popupYn}, SYSDATE, #{createId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE T3000_MENU SET MENU_NAME = #{menuName}, MENU_URL = #{menuUrl}, PARENT_MENU_ID = #{parentMenuId}, SEQ = #{seq}, POPUP_YN = #{popupYn}, UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE T3000_MENU SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}
